name: @funcd/example-s3-roundtrip
description: A funcd S3-frontend example (ADR-0080/0085, F47): a function that on invoke uses its funcd-INJECTED keypair (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET/REGION/ENDPOINT_URL_S3, all set by the daemon for a spec.blob function) + a bundled @aws-sdk/client-s3 to round-trip S3 against the gateway — PutObject/GetObject/ListObjectsV2 on the OWNED gold prefix (allowed) and a PutObject on an unbound prefix (403 AccessDenied from the Cedar PEP). Authored in TypeScript against @funcd/shim-nodejs; build.ts esbuild-bundles the handler + the AWS SDK to a single self-contained roundtrip.mjs.
